name: Nanami Shiori
source:
The eldest of the five Nanami sisters

She's a carefree woman who combines maturity and childishness. She embraces the protagonist with her gentle personality, but most conversations with her don't flow well

She also has a penchant for piercing your heart, so you have to be careful.

She typically scolds Kyouka for her antics.

[Translated from [url=https://www.akabeesoft3.com/products/bokuumi/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
